snippet.title: FrostyGamesFest Trailer Finely Diced
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

The team at Yuriosity games has completely revamped the menu in Finely Diced, so take a look at this new trailer showing off the game’s new Iron Chef-inspired cooking tournament roguelike gameplay – along with new character art, entirely redone UI and dice-building mechanics. 

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2357970/Finely_Diced/ 

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
